company.name: Caviar
company.shortDescription: Caviar is a delivery solution for consumers to order food from local eateries with the ability to live-track the order on a map.
company.description:
Caviar is the easiest way for consumers and businesses to order food from favorite local eateries with the ability to live-track the order on a map. Browse a picture menu, place the order, and we'll deliver within 1 hour.

Caviar offers restaurants a delivery solution in just a few minutes without any infrastructure, logistical, or operational costs.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that allows consumers to order food from local restaurants for delivery or pickup, with options to schedule orders and track delivery status.

productsAndServices.description: A subscription service offering reduced or zero delivery and service fees on eligible food orders through Caviar.
